Accounts Receivable.formula:
=SORT(
UNIQUE(
FILTER(
UPPER('Sales Database'!C6:C1996),
'Sales Database'!C6:C1996<>"",
BYROW(
UPPER('Sales Database'!C6:C1996),
LAMBDA(x,
SUMIF(UPPER('Sales Database'!C6:C1996),x,'Sales Database'!O6:O1996)
-
SUMIF(UPPER('Sales Database'!C6:C1996),x,'Sal"&"es Database'!S6:S1996)
>0
)
)
)
),
1,TRUE)"),"NAME
